ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Gies College of Business majors and Ag ACCY majors. Students who entered the University of Illinois in fall 2018 -- the prerequisite is listed above in the course description. Students who entered the University of Illinois prior to fall 2018 -- the prerequisite is ACCY 202 or equivalent; ECON 203 or equivalent or concurrent enrollment; and recommend concurrent enrollment in ACCY 301 for Accountancy majors. Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisites for previous accountancy courses taken.
